dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple high-contrast light-toned 'O' and 'C' shaped ring structures are visible on the posterior dorsal region, characterized by a sharp perimeter gradient transitioning from the dark base coat to the light-intensity ring edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, irregular light-colored pixel clusters with uniform internal intensity, concentrated primarily along the mid-dorsal line and interspersed between larger ring structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A prominent scalene triangle is formed by the centroids of three large annuli on the upper posterior flank, with an adjacent series of four high-intensity blobs forming a semi-linear arrangement extending anteriorly.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent dark-toned posterior tail fluke structure featuring five distinct lobes with well-defined scalloped edges.
